reviews.name: Sair Khan
reviews.text:
The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught that Muslims—whether from the North or the East, Arab or non-Arab, Black or White—are all brothers and sisters.

Last night, I wanted to pray, but someone insulted me. I do not understand why some people have so little profound knowledge of Islam. A man loudly demanded—in front of others—that I wash myself before entering the mosque. Is insulting people in the spirit of Islam? He did not know where I had come from; I had arrived straight from work. No one had ever insulted me before, yet this one man did so yesterday. He could have spoken to me privately, but unfortunately, he did so very loudly. I believe he holds a position of responsibility there and may have even helped fund the mosque. He was very rude and arrogant... Such people ought to learn how to behave appropriately.

I will never visit that mosque again; I have found another one nearby—a Turkish mosque.

Money isn't everything; while that man may have achieved some financial success, he has forgotten his own impoverished past and treated poor people disrespectfully.

Poslanik (mir neka je s njim) je učio da su muslimani - bilo sa sjevera ili istoka, Arapi ili nearapski, crni ili bijeli - svi braća i sestre.

Sinoć sam htio klanjati, ali me je neko uvrijedio. Ne razumijem zašto neki ljudi imaju tako malo dubinskog znanja o islamu. Jedan čovjek je glasno zahtijevao da se abdestiram prije ulaska u džamiju pred drugim ljudima. Je li u skladu s islamom vrijeđati ljude? Nije znao odakle dolazim: došao sam direktno s posla. Niko me nikada prije nije uvrijedio, ali ovaj jedan čovjek jeste jučer. Mogao je razgovarati sa mnom nasamo, ali nažalost, učinio je to vrlo glasno. Vjerujem da on tamo zauzima odgovornu poziciju i možda je čak pomogao u finansiranju džamije. Bio je vrlo neprijateljski raspoložen i arogantan. Takvi ljudi bi trebali naučiti kako se prikladno ponašati.

Nikada više neću posjetiti tu džamiju; pronašao sam drugu u blizini - tursku džamiju.

Novac nije sve; ovaj čovjek je možda nešto zaradio, ali je zaboravio svoju siromašnu prošlost i nepoštovao je siromašne ljude.

Vielen Dank für Ihre Rückmeldung.

Schade, dass Sie Ihren Besuch bei uns so negativ empfunden haben. Wir möchten allerdings zwei Punkte richtigstellen: 
Unser Islamisch-Albanisches Zentrum verfügt selbstverständlich über Parkmöglichkeiten, und auch ein separater Gebetsbereich für Frauen ist vorhanden.
Möglicherweise waren Ihnen die entsprechenden Bereiche bei Ihrem Besuch nicht bekannt oder Sie haben sie nicht gefunden. In diesem Fall hätten Sie uns jederzeit gerne ansprechen können.

Wir bedauern, dass Sie aufgrund dieser offenbar fehlenden Orientierung gleich eine 1 Stern Bewertung abgegeben haben. Wir hätten uns sehr gefreut, wenn Sie uns zunächst angesprochen hätten, damit wir Ihnen direkt weiterhelfen können.

Für einen erneuten Besuch sind Sie selbstverständlich herzlich willkommen.

reviews.name: SA AR
reviews.text:
من أجمل المراكز الإسلامية التي زرتها في ألمانيا. يتميز Landesverband der Islamischen Kulturzentren Baden-Württemberg e. V. بحسن التنظيم، والنظافة، والأجواء الهادئة التي تساعد على أداء العبادة بكل راحة وخشوع. المسجد واسع ومهيأ بشكل ممتاز، ويستقبل المصلين والزوار بكل ترحاب، كما أن مستوى العناية بالمرافق يعكس اهتمامًا واضحًا بالمكان ورواده.

أكثر ما أعجبني هو حسن الاستقبال وكرم الضيافة، حيث كان التعامل راقيًا ومليئًا بالاحترام، وشعرت بروح الأخوة منذ لحظة الدخول. كما يقدم المركز أنشطة دينية وثقافية وتعليمية تخدم مختلف فئات المجتمع، ويؤدي دورًا مهمًا في تعزيز التعايش والتواصل الإيجابي داخل المجتمع الألماني.

ويتميز موقعه أيضًا بسهولة الوصول، مع توفر مرافق جيدة تجعل زيارة المسجد مريحة سواء للمقيمين أو الزوار. إذا كنت في مدينة شتوتغارت أو المناطق القريبة، فأوصي بزيارة هذا المركز، سواء لأداء الصلاة أو للتعرف على أنشطته وجهوده في خدمة المجتمع.

بكل أمانة، مكان يستحق كل التقدير، وأسأل الله أن يبارك في القائمين عليه ويجزيهم خير الجزاء على ما يقدمونه من خدمة للمسلمين.
reviews.textTranslated:
One of the most beautiful Islamic centers I've visited in Germany. The Landesverband der Islamischen Kulturzentren Baden-Württemberg e. V. is distinguished by its excellent organization, cleanliness, and tranquil atmosphere, conducive to worship and devotion. The mosque is spacious and superbly equipped, warmly welcoming worshippers and visitors. The high level of care given to the facilities reflects a clear commitment to the place and its users.

What impressed me most was the warm welcome and generous hospitality. The staff were refined and respectful, and I felt a sense of brotherhood from the moment I entered. The center also offers religious, cultural, and educational activities that serve diverse segments of society and plays a vital role in promoting coexistence and positive communication within German society.

Its location is also easily accessible, with excellent facilities that make visiting the mosque convenient for both residents and visitors. If you are in Stuttgart or the surrounding areas, I highly recommend visiting this center, whether for prayer or to learn about its activities and efforts in serving the community.

Honestly, it is a place that deserves all appreciation, and I ask God to bless those in charge of it and reward them with the best reward for the service they provide to Muslims.

reviews.textTranslated: A truly excellent organization... They offer exceptionally well-organized services, and I thoroughly enjoyed all the activities I participated in. I wish them all the best.

reviews.name: Masoud Mohseni
reviews.text:
Diese Moschee ist sehr gut ausgestattet und erfüllt alle wichtigen Anforderungen.
Außerdem verfügt die Moschee über eine Küche sowie einen sehr geeigneten Raum für religiöse Veranstaltungen.
Insgesamt eine sehr angenehme und gut organisierte Moschee.
reviews.textTranslated:
This mosque is very well-equipped and meets all essential requirements.

Furthermore, the mosque has a kitchen and a very suitable room for religious services.

Overall, a very pleasant and well-organized mosque.

reviews.name: Amir
reviews.text:
Nette Afghanische Brüder und sauber Moderne Moschee, sie geben Khutba Freitag in Paschto Sprache.

Sie vorbereiten Iftar während Ramadan ! 🌿💚 Machallah
reviews.textTranslated:
Kind Afghan brothers and a clean, modern mosque; they give Khutbahs in Pashto on Fridays.

They are preparing Iftar during Ramadan! 🌿💚 Machallah
